improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try 3 free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, unlimited workspace. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-gideon-preview.png">
<meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
<meta name="twitter:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="Your professional AI assistant for trade and operations. Try 3 free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
improvements.rationale: These tags improve search visibility by clearly communicating what Gideon offers and who it serves. The meta description stays under 160 characters and includes the free trial hook plus pricing to set expectations. Open Graph and Twitter tags ensure professional previews when shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including the low entry price (US$2/day) in descriptions reduces friction and pre-qualifies clicks.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional guidance for your business operations. Try three free searches today."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product by name and clearly states its function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional guidance) while emphasizing the zero-risk free trial offer to drive conversions. The copy is concise, avoids unverifiable claims, and creates a clear path to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join GDN AI as a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day and gives you unlimited access to Gideon, including voice chat and your own members workspace—everything you need to keep your business moving.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point for new visitors: understanding the free-to-paid transition. It reassures prospects that the trial is genuinely free, clearly states the low entry price, and highlights key member benefits, reducing hesitation and improving conversion at the paywall moment.
